name: Sayuri Kuonji
source:
Born 12/03/2033
The daughter of the president of the global conglomerate 'Kuonji Group'.
She joins the UFN army to rebel against her meddling arms dealer father.

The protagonist of Sayuri Hen and a capturable character in Shirou Hen.
